data.name: Codex-Named Unit (trait_inner_sea_gods_isg_abilities_lst_252)
data.description: You are skilled in passing along knowledge of rural matters. If you have 4 or more ranks in Knowledge (Nature) or Survival, when you aid another with these skills, you grant a +4 bonus on the check you are aiding instead of the normal +2.
